title: Settlement Manipulation in Prediction Markets
abstract: arXiv:2606.31675v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Prediction markets increasingly list contracts settling on an asset price that holders can move by trading the underlying. We build a model showing that such contracts transfer wealth from prediction-market liquidity traders to manipulators and the prediction-market maker and harm price discovery in the underlying, even as it becomes more liquid. After the launch of Polymarket's five-minute Bitcoin contract, settlement-time spot order flow spikes, causing large price reversals after settlement. Manipulators capture a large amount of profit, mostly from retail. Manipulation is largely absent in the fifteen-minute contracts, and it disappeared from the five-minute contract once Polymarket began settling on a 60-second average price: lengthening the horizon or averaging the settlement price removes it.

translated_title: 预测市场中的结算操纵
translated_abstract: 预测市场越来越多地挂牌以某种资产价格进行结算的合约，而持有者可以通过交易该标的资产来推动这一价格。我们构建了一个模型，表明这类合约会将财富从预测市场的流动性交易者转移给操纵者和预测市场做市商，并且即使标的资产流动性提高，也会损害其价格发现功能。在Polymarket推出五分钟比特币合约后，结算时点的现货订单流出现激增，导致结算后价格出现大幅反转。操纵者获取了大量利润，其来源主要是散户。在十五分钟合约中，操纵现象基本不存在；而当Polymarket开始采用60秒平均价格进行结算后，五分钟合约中的操纵也随之消失：延长合约期限或对结算价格取平均值即可消除这种操纵。
tldr: 本文通过理论模型与Polymarket比特币合约的实证数据证明，以可被交易推动的资产价格结算的短期预测合约会将财富从流动性交易者转移给操纵者和做市商并损害价格发现，而延长合约期限或采用平均价格结算即可消除这种操纵。
en_tdlr: Short-term prediction-market contracts settled on an asset price that traders can move transfer wealth from liquidity traders to manipulators and the market maker while harming price discovery; lengthening the contract horizon or settling on an averaged price eliminates the manipulation.
